svg.title: Stomach side effects: drug vs placebo, from each label
svg.desc: Stomach side effects: drug vs placebo, from each label. Efpeglenatide (Eppe), 40 wk: nausea 16.6% vs 5.4% on placebo, diarrhea 17.6% vs 4.8% on placebo, vomiting 11.6% vs 2.0% on placebo. Wegovy, US label: nausea 44% vs 16% on placebo, diarrhea 30% vs 16% on placebo, vomiting 24% vs 6% on placebo. Zepbound highest dose, US label: nausea 28% vs 8% on placebo, diarrhea 23% vs 8% on placebo, vomiting 13% vs 2% on placebo.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
